name: Ankle Trap (1-2)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-04: Bandits of Immenwood

disable: If spotted, the pits can be avoided by moving at one quarter of normal speed.

items.name: Trip Up
items.text:
Trigger A creature walks into the affected area

---

Effect Any creature that walks through the affected area must attempt a DC 14 Acrobatics check check. Creatures that fail this check take 1d4 bludgeoning damage and a –5-foot penalty to their Speed for 1 hour. A critical failure increases the damage to 2d4 bludgeoning damage and reduces the creature's Speed by half for 1 hour.

text: Many small pits have been dug in the road and covered with leaves and dirt to disguise them.
